title: ipomoea batatas var. xanthorhiza
intro: Ipomoea batatas var. xanthorhiza, commonly known as Yellow yam or Lesser yam, is a variety of yam that is native to Southeast Asia. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent due to its therapeutic actions such as vasodilation and antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Ipomoea batatas var. xanthorhiza include starch, alkaloids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties. The health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions.
